user.title: App-Statistiken
user.description:
Enter the read-only keys for Apple, Google or both (the other store can be added later via Reconfigure).

- **Apple:** an App Store Connect API key with only the role **Sales**.
- **Google:** a service account with only **View app information and download bulk reports**.

Step-by-step guide: [https://github.com/dosje/app-stats#setup](https://github.com/dosje/app-stats#setup)

data.apple_private_key: Apple private key (content of the .p8 file)
data.google_service_account: Google service account (content of the JSON key file)

data_description.apple_issuer_id: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API → Team Keys. Shown above the list of keys (a long ID with dashes).
data_description.apple_key_id: The 10-character Key ID in the row of the key you created (role: Sales).
data_description.apple_vendor_number: App Store Connect → Payments and Financial Reports: the number at the top left, under the account name (8 digits, usually starting with 8). Also shown in Sales and Trends → Reports.
data_description.apple_private_key: Full content of the downloaded AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 file, including the BEGIN/END lines. Apple lets you download it only once. On a Mac: pbcopy < AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 copies it exactly.
data_description.google_bucket: Play Console → Download reports → Statistics → "Copy Cloud Storage URI". Looks like gs://pubsite_prod_…; anything after the bucket name is ignored.
data_description.google_service_account: Full content of the service account's JSON key file (Google Cloud → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → Keys → Add key → JSON). Invite the account's email in Play Console → Users and permissions with only "View app information and download bulk reports".

reconfigure.title: Change keys
reconfigure.description: Leave the key fields empty to keep the stored keys.

error.nothing_entered: Enter the keys for at least one store.
error.apple_incomplete: Apple: all four fields are needed.
error.google_incomplete: Google: bucket and service account are both needed.
error.apple_auth: Apple rejected the key (check Issuer ID, Key ID, .p8 content and the Sales role).
error.google_auth: Google rejected the service account or it has no access to the bucket.

init.title: Apps
init.description: Link each Google Play app to the same app in the App Store to get combined totals. Apps found: {apple_count} App Store, {google_count} Google Play.

data.include_redownloads: Count App Store re-downloads as installs

data_description.scan_interval_hours: How often the stores are checked (default 6 h). Both stores publish new numbers once a day.
